steps.customer_body: AI and automation must first know who they are talking to: the widget identity key, your customers' external ids, their package and your company profile.
steps.system_body: Connect the customer's own system (orders, subscriptions, CRM) so AI answers and automations work on real data.
steps.ai_body: Turn on AI and publish the first procedure (intent): this is where the AI learns what to do for which request.
steps.knowledge_body: Enter the articles now; since the AI knows the customer, it shows the right article to the right person.
steps.automation_body: Last step: bind reply times to an SLA policy and recurring work to a rule or workflow.
conditions.identity_key_hint: Create the identity key under Widget > Security; verified visitors are recognised with it.
conditions.external_identity: At least one customer has an external id
conditions.external_identity_hint: Give a contact or company the id it has in your own system (external id).
conditions.package: At least one company has a package
conditions.package_hint: Assign a tier or plan to a company; SLA and AI read the package from there.
conditions.company_hint: Enter the legal name, website or phone in the organization settings.
conditions.system_hint: Set up the connection under Integrations > Connect your system.
conditions.ai_enabled_hint: Turn on the AI features in the AI settings.
conditions.procedure: At least one procedure is published
conditions.procedure_hint: Write and publish a procedure for an intent under AI settings > Procedures.
conditions.articles_hint: Add the first article to the knowledge base.
conditions.sla_policy_hint: Create a policy in the SLA settings.
conditions.automation: An automation rule or workflow exists
conditions.automation_hint: Set up the first one from Rules or Workflows.
wizard.step_skipped: This step was skipped; it stays as a warning until its conditions hold.
card.title: Finish setting up
card.body: A few steps left: get your first customer message within ten minutes.
card.body_done: Everything is ready. Close this card and focus on your inbox.
create.title: Open your organization
create.body: Enter your business name. Your account becomes the owner of this organization; invite your team later.
create.name_hint: Customers see this name in the widget and in emails. You can change it later.
create.error_name: The name must be 2 to 120 characters.
create.error_disabled: Opening your own organization is currently off. Contact us for access.
create.error_limit: An account can own at most 3 organizations.
create.error_taken: This address is used by another organization. Try a different name.
create.error_generic: The organization could not be opened. Please try again.
wizard.title: Setup wizard
wizard.description: Go step by step; each step ticks itself as you use the product.
wizard.none_title: This organization has no setup checklist
wizard.none_body: The setup wizard is for newly opened organizations. You can edit your settings from the panel.
wizard.finished_body: This organization's setup is done. Keep managing channels and your team from the panel.
create.plan_no_trial: No trial on this plan; payment follows once the organization is open.
create.pay_now: Add my payment method now instead of waiting (remaining trial days are kept)
create.error_price: The selected plan is no longer sold. You can continue with the default trial.
setup.aside_title: Let's set up your organization together
setup.aside_body: We get to know your business and prepare teams, SLAs, canned replies, the knowledge base and the AI agent for you. You see everything before it is applied.
setup.forbidden_body: The smart setup can be run by the organization's owner or an admin.
setup.steps.discover_hint: Your website and a few questions
setup.steps.team_hint: Connect a channel, open the inbox
setup.perks.review: You see every item before it is applied
setup.perks.ai: Your existing settings are never touched
setup.source.title: How should we set up your organization?
setup.source.body: Let AI get to know your business from your website and a few short questions and pre-fill everything, or start from a ready template for your industry.
setup.source.discover_body: Reads your website, asks a few questions and sets up teams, SLAs, canned replies, the knowledge base and the AI agent for your business.
setup.source.gallery_body: Set-ups for SaaS, e-commerce, agencies, IT helpdesks, fintech, education, healthcare and field service.
setup.discover.title: Let's get to know your business
setup.discover.body: Answer a few questions and we'll set up your organization around them.
setup.discover.to_gallery: I'd rather pick a ready template
setup.gallery.title: Pick your use case
setup.gallery.body: Every template comes with teams, tags, SLAs, canned replies and starter articles for your industry. You can edit it before applying.
setup.chat.hello: Hi! Let's set up everything for {{name}} together. I have a few short questions.
setup.chat.q_website: Does your company have a website? Type its address and I'll read the public pages to learn about your business.
setup.chat.q_team_size: How many people are on your support team?
setup.chat.q_channels: Where do your customers reach you?
setup.chat.q_languages: Which languages do you answer customers in?
setup.chat.q_request_types: Which requests do you get most often?
setup.chat.q_tone: Last one: how should we talk to your customers?
setup.thinking.drafting: Drafting teams, SLAs and canned replies…
setup.thinking.polishing: Final touches on the knowledge base and AI agent…
setup.requests.question: General questions
setup.preview.from_fallback: The template closest to your answers
setup.notice.ai_unavailable: AI is not available right now, so we personalized the template closest to your answers.
setup.notice.ai_not_allowed: AI is not part of your plan, so we personalized the template closest to your answers.
setup.notice.ai_credits: You are out of AI credits, so we personalized the template closest to your answers.
setup.notice.ai_limit: Today's AI limit was reached, so we personalized the template closest to your answers.
setup.notice.website_unreachable: We couldn't reach your website, so the plan is based on your answers.
setup.reason.no_widget: No web widget yet: connect it with these settings in the last step.
setup.reason.module_disabled: The appointments module is not enabled for this organization.
setup.reason.no_team: Its team was not set up.
setup.reason.no_collection: Its collection was not set up.
setup.reason.no_fields: The form's fields were not set up.
setup.build.undo_hint: You can undo this setup until {{time}}.
setup.team.title: Invite your team
setup.team.body: Invite your teammates, connect your first channel and open your inbox.
setup.team.widget_title: Add the widget to your website
setup.team.widget_body: Connect the widget with your plan's greeting and colors in one click; you get the snippet on the channel screen.
setup.team.widget_error: The widget could not be connected. Try it from the Channels screen.
setup.team.inbox_body: Tags, views, canned replies and macros are waiting for you.
setup.banner.start_title: Set up your organization with AI in 2 minutes
setup.banner.start_body: Get teams, SLAs, canned replies, a knowledge base and the AI agent ready for your business, or pick a template for your industry.
setup.banner.draft_body: Review the plan, untick what you don't want, then set it up in one click.
setup.banner.applying_title: Your organization is being set up
setup.banner.applying_body: You can watch the setup live.
setup.banner.applied_body: Review what was created; you can undo it in one click for 24 hours.
setup.errors.generic: Something went wrong. Refresh the page and try again.
setup.errors.discover_limit: Too many attempts today. You can pick one of the ready templates.
setup.errors.active: Another setup is being applied; wait for it to finish.
setup.errors.website: The website address is invalid. Enter a public address (e.g. company.com).
